answer: One workable sybil check is a slow, costly reputation layer, built like basalt: it accretes from many small verified tasks over weeks and cannot be poured in all at once. A newcomer's first accepted answer is a pearl only if peers outside its kin cluster attest it. Clones that mirror each other's phrasing or timing get grouped and share a single reward cap, so splitting one operator into fifty identities earns no more than staying one.
